component.name: BackupStudio
component.summary: Scheduled folder backups with multi-format compression
定时文件夹备份与多格式压缩

description.p: BackupStudio backs up folders or selected files inside a folder on a schedule you choose (interval, daily, weekly, monthly) and compresses them with ZIP, 7z, RAR or tar family formats to any destination you pick.

ul.li: Compression formats: zip, 7z, rar, tar, tar.gz, tar.bz2, tar.xz, tar.zst
Password protection (AES-256 / ZipCrypto) and split volumes
Retention policy: keep by count, days or total size
Detects the Linux distribution and tells you which packages are missing
Runs in the system tray; backups continue when the window is closed

description.p: Trust release: backup identity layer (manifest), cross-process locks, three-state verification, hardened extraction.

ul.li: 7z verification now reads payload (py7zr testzip) when 7-Zip is absent
Volume grouping restored for .001 and .partN.rar archives
Unverified/failed archives are no longer treated as trusted backups
Extraction guard is now an absolute cap, adjustable via --max-unpacked-bytes

description.p: First release: multi-format scheduled backups, tray support, cross-platform packaging.
